name: Gombosszeg (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, green at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Gombosszeg: a blue and green shield with a yellow belfry and a wavy stripe.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
